title: 我的身体
intro: Head, shoulders, knees and toes, Chinese style: body parts, the senses, and the first action verbs (看 听 说 吃 喝 走 跑 跳). Pattern of the unit: body part + 疼 for 'it hurts', and 用 + body part + verb.

items.note: As a suffix it's neutral: 石头 shí tou, 里头 lǐ tou.

ex.p: mā ma mō mo wǒ de tóu

items.note: Body hair and fur is 毛 máo.

ex.p: mèi mei de tóu fa hěn cháng
ex.en: My little sister's hair is long.
In the morning I wash my face.

ex.p: tā de yǎn jing hěn dà
tù zi de ěr duo hěn cháng

items.note: Chinese point at their own nose to say 'me?'.

ex.p: dà xiàng de bí zi hěn cháng

items.note: Plain 嘴 zuǐ is also common. 口 is the written/compound form (人口, 门口).

ex.p: xiǎo māo de zuǐ ba hěn xiǎo

ex.en: I brush my teeth every day.

ex.p: wǒ yǒu shí gēn shǒu zhǐ
bǎo bao de shǒu zhǐ hěn xiǎo
bà ba de jiǎo hěn dà
shuì jiào qián yào xǐ jiǎo
gē ge de tuǐ hěn cháng
ex.en: My big brother's legs are long.

ex.p: wǒ de dù zi è le

items.note: 身体很好 usually means 'in good health'.

ex.p: yé ye de shēn tǐ hěn hǎo
duō hē shuǐ shēn tǐ hǎo
ex.en: Drink lots of water and you'll be healthy.

items.note: Body part + 疼: 我头疼. In the south people also say 痛 tòng.

items.en: to look at, watch; to read

items.note: 听话 tīng huà: to be obedient (lit. listen to what's said).

ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan tīng ér gē
ex.en: I like listening to nursery rhymes.

ex.p: bǎo bao huì shuō huà le

items.note: Soup is drunk, not eaten: 喝汤.
In written Chinese 闻 also means 'to hear' (新闻 news).

ex.en: Have a sniff: it smells great!

ex.p: xiǎo gǒu yòng bí zi wén
ex.en: The puppy sniffs with its nose.

items.note: 用 + tool + verb: 用筷子吃饭 eat with chopsticks.

items.en: can (know how to, learned skill); will
items.note: 会 = learned ability (会游泳). 能 = physically able / allowed (later).

ex.p: wǒ huì xiě wǒ de míng zi

items.note: 走 is 'walk', not 'run' (跑). In old Chinese it meant run: hence the radical in 起, 越.

ex.p: xiǎo gǒu pǎo de hěn kuài
chī fàn qián yào xǐ shǒu

头.h: Two tufts of hair above a big 大 person: the head.

发.h: Two old characters merged into one: 髮 fà hair and 發 fā send.

脸.h: Flesh 月 + 佥 for the sound.

眼.h: Eye 目 + 艮 for the sound.

睛.h: Eye 目 + 青 (bright): the bright part of the eye.

朵.m: (measure word for flowers); in 耳朵
朵.h: A flower drooping from a tree 木. In 耳朵 it's neutral.

鼻.h: 自 was first a drawing of a nose; that's why you point at your nose to say 'me'.

巴.m: (noun suffix in 嘴巴, 尾巴)
巴.h: Once a coiled snake; now a light suffix.

牙.h: Upper and lower teeth biting together.

指.h: Hand 扌 + 旨 for the sound.

脚.h: Flesh 月 + 却 for the sound.

腿.h: Flesh 月 + 退 tuì (step back): the leg you step back with.

肚.h: Flesh 月 + 土 for the sound.

身.h: A person with a big round belly, seen from the side.

体.h: A person's 亻 root 本: the body. Traditional 體 has 23 strokes!

看.h: A hand 手 shading the eyes 目 to look far away.

听.h: Mouth 口 + 斤 for the sound. Traditional 聽 contains an ear 耳.

说.h: Speech 讠 + 兑: to say.

吃.h: Mouth 口 + 乞 for the sound.

喝.h: Mouth 口 + 曷 for the sound.

闻.h: An ear 耳 at the door 门, catching news.

用.h: A bucket with a handle: something you use.

会.h: People 人 gathering like clouds 云: a meeting; also 'know how to'.

走.h: A person swinging their arms above a foot 止: walking.

跑.h: Foot ⻊ + 包 bāo for the sound.

洗.h: Water 氵 + 先 (first): wash first!

疼.h: The sickness radical 疒 + 冬 winter: aches when it's cold.

摸.h: Hand 扌 + 莫 for the sound.

lines.p: xiǎo yǎn jing kàn yī kàn
xiǎo ěr duo tīng yī tīng
xiǎo bí zi wén yī wén
xiǎo zuǐ ba shuō yī shuō
xiǎo xiǎo shǒu mō yī mō
xiǎo xiǎo jiǎo tiào yī tiào

notes: Verb + 一 + verb (看一看) means 'have a quick go'. The 一 is neutral: kàn yi kàn.
Point to each body part as you recite.

texts.title: 小明肚子疼

lines.p: xiǎo míng chī le hěn duō táng
lines.en: Xiaoming ate a lot of candy.

lines.zh: 晚上，他说：“妈妈，我肚子疼。”
lines.p: wǎn shang tā shuō mā ma wǒ dù zi téng
lines.en: In the evening he said, 'Mom, my tummy hurts.'

lines.zh: 妈妈摸摸他的肚子，说：“不怕，不怕。”
lines.p: mā ma mō mo tā de dù zi shuō bù pà bù pà
lines.en: Mom rubbed his tummy and said, 'Don't be scared.'

lines.p: nǐ chī le jǐ kuài táng

lines.zh: 妈妈笑了：“明天少吃一点儿糖，多喝水。”
lines.p: mā ma xiào le míng tiān shǎo chī yī diǎnr táng duō hē shuǐ
lines.en: Mom laughed: 'Tomorrow eat less candy and drink more water.'

lines.zh: 第二天，小明的肚子不疼了。
lines.p: dì èr tiān xiǎo míng de dù zi bù téng le
lines.en: The next day, Xiaoming's tummy didn't hurt any more.

notes: 少吃 / 多喝: 少 and 多 go before the verb to mean 'eat less / drink more'.
不疼了: 了 after a negative = 'not any more'.

exercises.why: Liquids take 喝 (喝水, 喝牛奶, 喝汤); solid food takes 吃.
Body part before 疼: 我 + 肚子 + 疼.

exercises.p: mā ma mō mo wǒ de tóu

exercises.why: 手指 finger · 洗手 wash hands · 小手 little hand.

scenario.title: 看医生
scenario.setting: You're five and you feel sick. Mom takes you to the doctor.

a.p: xiǎo péng you nǐ nǎr bù shū fu
a.en: Little one, where don't you feel well?

opts.fb: Order: 我肚子疼 (the body part comes first).

b.p: zhāng kāi zuǐ ba shuō a

b2.npc: 头疼？你昨天晚上几点睡觉？
b2.p: tóu téng nǐ zuó tiān wǎn shang jǐ diǎn shuì jiào
b2.en: A headache? What time did you go to bed last night?

opts.fb: The doctor won't like that! (bú shuì jiào)

c.npc: 没事儿。多喝水，好好休息。
c.p: méi shìr duō hē shuǐ hǎo hǎo xiū xi
c.en: It's nothing serious. Drink lots of water and rest well.

opts.p: hǎo de xiè xie ā yí
opts.fb: Children call any woman their parents' age 阿姨.

d.p: bù kè qi zài jiàn xiǎo péng you
